title: Bharata experiences a bad dream
introduction: Bharata experiences a bad dream on that very night in which the messengers entered the city of Girivraja. His friends in the palace arranged entertainment like recitation of stories, playing of musical instruments, stage plays and jokes to make him cheerful. Even then, his depression was not gone. Bharata explains in detail his unpleasant dream in its different forms to his friends.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनसप्ततितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 69th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
याम् एव रात्रिम् ते दूताः प्रविशन्ति स्म ताम् पुरीम् |
भरतेन अपि ताम् रात्रिम् स्वप्नो दृष्टः अयम् अप्रियः
verses.iast:
yām eva rātrim te dūtāḥ praviśanti sma tām purīm |
bharatena api tām rātrim svapno dṛṣṭaḥ ayam apriyaḥ
verses.translation: On that very night those messengers entered the city; Bharata also had experienced an unpleasant dream.

verses.devanagari:
व्युष्टाम् एव तु ताम् रात्रिम् दृष्ट्वा तम् स्वप्नम् अप्रियम् |
पुत्रः राज अधिराजस्य सुभृशम् पर्यतप्यत
verses.iast:
vyuṣṭām eva tu tām rātrim dṛṣṭvā tam svapnam apriyam |
putraḥ rāja adhirājasya subhṛśam paryatapyata
verses.translation: Bharata, the son of Dasaratha the paramount sovereign, after seeing that unpleasant dream just at the dawn of that night, felt very much anguished.

verses.devanagari:
तप्यमानम् समाज्ञाय वयस्याः प्रिय वादिनः |
आयासम् हि विनेष्यन्तः सभायाम् चक्रिरे कथाः
verses.iast:
tapyamānam samāGYāya vayasyāḥ priya vādinaḥ |
āyāsam hi vineṣyantaḥ sabhāyām cakrire kathāḥ
verses.translation: Knowing Bharata to have been in anguish, his graceful speaking friends arranged recitation of stories in the palace; so as to erase his anguish.

verses.devanagari:
वादयन्ति तथा शान्तिम् लासयन्ति अपि च अपरे |
नाटकानि अपरे प्राहुर् हास्यानि विविधानि च
verses.iast:
vādayanti tathā śāntim lāsayanti api ca apare |
nāṭakāni apare prāhur hāsyāni vividhāni ca
verses.translation: Some played musical instruments for bringing about peacefulness. Likewise some others arranged for exhibition of dramas and some others told various types of jokes.

glosses.meaning: for his peacefulness. tathaa = In the same manner

verses.devanagari:
स तैः महात्मा भरतः सखिभिः प्रिय वादिभिः |
गोष्ठी हास्यानि कुर्वद्भिर् न प्राहृष्यत राघवः
verses.iast:
sa taiḥ mahātmā bharataḥ sakhibhiḥ priya vādibhiḥ |
goṣṭhī hāsyāni kurvadbhir na prāhṛṣyata rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: That high-soled Bharata born in Raghu Dynasty could not be made cheerful by his gently speaking friends by stage-plays or jokes.

verses.devanagari:
तम् अब्रवीत् प्रिय सखो भरतम् सखिभिर् वृतम् |
सुहृद्भिः पर्युपासीनः किम् सखे न अनुमोदसे
verses.iast:
tam abravīt priya sakho bharatam sakhibhir vṛtam |
suhṛdbhiḥ paryupāsīnaḥ kim sakhe na anumodase
verses.translation: A close friend spoke to Bharata, who was surrounded by his companions, as follows, "O, friend! Why are you not rejoicing, even when entertained by your friends?"

verses.devanagari:
एवम् ब्रुवाणम् सुहृदम् भरतः प्रत्युवाच ह |
शृणु त्वम् यन् निमित्तम्मे दैन्यम् एतत् उपागतम्
verses.iast:
evam bruvāṇam suhṛdam bharataḥ pratyuvāca ha |
śṛṇu tvam yan nimittamme dainyam etat upāgatam
verses.translation: Bharata replied to the friend who spoke thus, as follows "You listen to me the reason for which this depression came to me"

verses.devanagari:
स्वप्ने पितरम् अद्राक्षम् मलिनम् मुक्त मूर्धजम् |
पतन्तम् अद्रि शिखरात् कलुषे गोमये ह्रदे
verses.iast:
svapne pitaram adrākṣam malinam mukta mūrdhajam |
patantam adri śikharāt kaluṣe gomaye hrade
verses.translation: "I have seen a dream in which my father with his soiled body and with his hair disheveled, was falling from the top of a mountain into a polluted pond defiled with cow dung.

glosses.meaning: from the top of a mountain

verses.devanagari:
प्लवमानः च मे दृष्टः स तस्मिन् गोमय ह्रदे |
पिबन्न् अन्जलिना तैलम् हसन्न् इव मुहुर् मुहुः
verses.iast:
plavamānaḥ ca me dṛṣṭaḥ sa tasmin gomaya hrade |
pibann anjalinā tailam hasann iva muhur muhuḥ
verses.translation: "He was seen by me, as he was floating in that pond defiled with cow dung, drinking an oil through his hollowed palms and laughing again and again"

verses.devanagari:
ततः तिलोदनम् भुक्त्वा पुनः पुनर् अधः शिराः |
तैलेन अभ्यक्त सर्व अन्गः तैलम् एव अवगाहत
verses.iast:
tataḥ tilodanam bhuktvā punaḥ punar adhaḥ śirāḥ |
tailena abhyakta sarva angaḥ tailam eva avagāhata
verses.translation: "Thereafter, having eaten cooked rice mixed with gingelly seeds repeatedly, with his head bent down and with his whole body smeared with oil, he plunged into the oil itself

glosses.meaning: cooked rice mixed with gingelly seeds

verses.devanagari:
स्वप्ने अपि सागरम् शुष्कम् चन्द्रम् च पतितम् भुवि |
सहसा च अपि संशन्तम् ज्वलितम् जात वेदसम्
औपवाह्यस्य नागस्य विषाणम् शकलीकृतम् |
सहसा चापि संशान्तम् ज्वलितम् जातवेदसम्
अवदीर्णाम् च पृथिवीम् शुष्कामः च विविधान् द्रुमान् |
अहम् पश्यामि विध्वस्तान् सधूमामः चैव पार्वतान्
verses.iast:
svapne api sāgaram śuṣkam candram ca patitam bhuvi |
sahasā ca api saṃśantam jvalitam jāta vedasam
aupavāhyasya nāgasya viṣāṇam śakalīkṛtam |
sahasā cāpi saṃśāntam jvalitam jātavedasam
avadīrṇām ca pṛthivīm śuṣkāmḥ ca vividhān drumān |
aham paśyāmi vidhvastān sadhūmāmḥ caiva pārvatān
verses.translation: "I saw in the dream, the ocean dry up, the moon fall on the ground, the earth molested as if covered by darkness, a tusk of an elephant (on which the monarch rode) broken to pieces, a blazing fire suddenly extinguished, the earth riven, the various trees dry up, and the mountains whirl up into a mist."

verses.devanagari:
पीठे कार्ष्णायसे च एनम् निषण्णम् कृष्ण वाससम् |
प्रहसन्ति स्म राजानम् प्रमदाः कृष्ण पिन्गलाः
verses.iast:
pīṭhe kārṣṇāyase ca enam niṣaṇṇam kṛṣṇa vāsasam |
prahasanti sma rājānam pramadāḥ kṛṣṇa pingalāḥ
verses.translation: "I saw my father in the dream, wearing black clothes, sitting on a stool made of iron and women with black and reddish brown complexion deriding the king."

verses.devanagari:
त्वरमाणः च धर्म आत्मा रक्त माल्य अनुलेपनः |
रथेन खर युक्तेन प्रयातः दक्षिणा मुखः
verses.iast:
tvaramāṇaḥ ca dharma ātmā rakta mālya anulepanaḥ |
rathena khara yuktena prayātaḥ dakṣiṇā mukhaḥ
verses.translation: "My father, the virtuous man, adorned with red garlands and his body besmeared with sandal paste and seated in a chariot drawn by asses, proceeded hurriedly towards the south."

glosses.meaning: adorned with red garlands and his body besmeared with sandal paste

verses.devanagari:
प्रहसन्तीव राजानम् प्रमदा रक्तवासिनी |
प्रकर्षन्ती मया दृष्टा राक्षसी विकृतासना
verses.iast:
prahasantīva rājānam pramadā raktavāsinī |
prakarṣantī mayā dṛṣṭā rākśasī vikṛtāsanā
verses.translation: "I saw an ugly faced female demon, wearing red colored clothes, laughingly dragging away the king.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् एतन् मया दृष्टम् इमाम् रात्रिम् भय आवहाम् |
अहम् रामः अथ वा राजा लक्ष्मणो वा मरिष्यति
verses.iast:
evam etan mayā dṛṣṭam imām rātrim bhaya āvahām |
aham rāmaḥ atha vā rājā lakṣmaṇo vā mariṣyati
verses.translation: "This fearful dream was seen thus by me during that night. I myself or the king or Lakshmana may die."

verses.devanagari:
नरः यानेन यः स्वप्ने खर युक्तेन याति हि |
अचिरात् तस्य धूम अग्रम् चितायाम् सम्प्रदृश्यते
verses.iast:
naraḥ yānena yaḥ svapne khara yuktena yāti hi |
acirāt tasya dhūma agram citāyām sampradṛśyate
verses.translation: "If in a dream, a person sees a man going in a chariot, yoked with donkeys, the smoke of a funeral pyre will soon be seen ascending him."

verses.devanagari:
एतन् निमित्तम् दीनो अहम् तन् न वः प्रतिपूजये |
शुष्यति इव च मे कण्ठो न स्वस्थम् इव मे मनः
verses.iast:
etan nimittam dīno aham tan na vaḥ pratipūjaye |
śuṣyati iva ca me kaṇṭho na svastham iva me manaḥ
verses.translation: "For this reason, I have become broken hearted. Hence, I am not able to treat you properly. My throat seems to be drying up. My mind is not at ease."

glosses.meaning: I am not able to honor. vaH = you

verses.devanagari:
न पश्यामि भयस्थानम् भयम् चैवोपधारये |
भ्रष्टश्च स्वरयोगो मे चाया चोपहता मम
जुगुप्सन्न् इव च आत्मानम् न च पश्यामि कारणम् |
verses.iast:
na paśyāmi bhayasthānam bhayam caivopadhāraye |
bhraṣṭaśca svarayogo me cāyā copahatā mama
jugupsann iva ca ātmānam na ca paśyāmi kāraṇam |
verses.translation: "I do not see the root cause of this fear. But I am experiencing a fear indeed. My voice is choked. My luster is affected. I abhor me myself and I do not see a reason for it."

verses.devanagari:
इमाम् हि दुह्स्वप्न गतिम् निशाम्य ताम् |
अनेक रूपाम् अवितर्किताम् पुरा |
भयम् महत् तद्द् हृदयान् न याति मे |
विचिन्त्य राजानम् अचिन्त्य दर्शनम्
verses.iast:
imām hi duhsvapna gatim niśāmya tām |
aneka rūpām avitarkitām purā |
bhayam mahat tadd hṛdayān na yāti me |
vicintya rājānam acintya darśanam
verses.translation: "That great fear is not going away from my heart, having seen such a course of this bad dream in varied forms and which dream was not imagined by me earlier and also reflecting on that inconceivable sight of the king."

glosses.meaning: a course of a bad dream
